name: Monitor EU tenders with Apify and store new notices in n8n

parameters.content:
## Monitor EU tenders with Apify and store new notices in n8n

### How it works

This workflow monitors EU TED tenders by running a persistent Apify Actor Task either manually or on a daily schedule. After the task completes, it verifies that a default dataset exists, fetches its records, prepares them, and upserts new or changed notices into an n8n Data Table. Terminal code nodes report whether ingestion succeeded, found no records, or the Apify run produced no dataset.

### Setup steps

- Configure Apify credentials in n8n for the Apify nodes.
- Set the correct persistent Apify Actor Task ID in the “Persistent Task configuration” node.
- Create or select the target n8n Data Table used by “Upsert committed TED records” and ensure its columns match the prepared TED record fields.
- Review the daily schedule trigger and activate the workflow when ready.

### Customization

Adjust the Apify Actor Task configuration to change tender search criteria, countries, CPV codes, or date ranges. You can also modify the preparation code and Data Table schema to store additional TED fields or change the deduplication/upsert key.

### Runtime note
This template uses the Apify community node. Creator Hub community-node templates are intended for self-hosted n8n unless your n8n Cloud workspace already provides this verified Apify node. Store Apify credentials only in n8n credential storage, never inside the exported JSON.

## Start and configure

Manual and scheduled entry points converge on a Set node that supplies the persistent Apify Actor Task ID used for TED monitoring.

## Run task and dataset

Runs the configured persistent Apify TED monitoring task, checks whether the completed run produced a default dataset, then either fetches that dataset or reports the no-dataset outcome.

## Prepare dataset records

Transforms each fetched dataset record into the workflow’s expected structure and checks whether there are any records to ingest.

## Store TED notices

Upserts committed TED records into an n8n Data Table when the dataset contains records.

## Report ingestion outcome

Creates the terminal summary after ingestion, including both the path where records were stored and the path where the dataset had no records.

nodes.name: Execute TED Monitoring Task
nodes.notes: Verified with @apify/n8n-nodes-apify 0.6.10. Run task with Wait for Finish returns the terminal run object for SUCCEEDED, FAILED, TIMED-OUT, and ABORTED without applying the combined operation's success-only dataset gate.

nodes.name: Fetch Dataset Records
nodes.notes: Fetches by the terminal run's defaultDatasetId for every status. This workflow is intentionally non-paginated: the retrieval limit is 1000 and the Actor appends exactly one summary control row, so the saved Task maxNewPerRun must be no greater than 999. Confirm that saved-Task cap during account-gated validation before activation. alwaysOutputData preserves the empty-dataset path.

nodes.name: Process Dataset Records
nodes.notes: All dataset rows are persisted. Tender identity remains ted:<publicationNumber>; summary or malformed control rows use a run-and-row fallback key. A null tender title is preserved in payloadJson and normalized.title; displayTitle is only a presentation fallback.

nodes.name: Upsert TED Records
nodes.notes: Create or select monitor-deliveries with the displayed columns. Upsert matches deliveryKey, so replaying ted:<publicationNumber> or a run-row fallback updates one row instead of inserting a duplicate.
